pages.text: A chassis starts **Basic**. Use an **upgrade kit** on it to raise it one tier: Hardened, then Reinforced, Signalum and Resonant. A kit only works on the tier just below it. Breaking the chassis gives every kit back.

rows: 1 bay, 1 stack per lane, 2,000 mB, 32,000 RF

pages.text: **Speed** makes every processor finish sooner and every engine burn faster. The RF per job and the RF per fuel stay the same, so a faster tier needs power delivered faster too. The bays take service-bay upgrades as usual.

Kits are made from plates and a gear: Hardened from steel plates and a bronze gear, Reinforced from electrum and steel, Signalum from signal alloy and electrum, Resonant from ender alloy and signal alloy.
